No feature may be advertised as available until verified and explicitly approved.

Products, categories, sizes and live stock
Supplier directory and basic inventory updates

plans.name: Growth
plans.eyebrow: For growing stores and small chains

plans.name: Business
plans.target: Growing chains needing a tailored rollout

Tailored onboarding and rollout discussion (subject to agreement)
Optional WhatsApp and Advanced Analytics add-ons

addOns.name: WhatsApp Marketing & Communication

addOns.billingDisclosure: Meta message and marketing charges are paid by the merchant directly to Meta. Stockiva subscription excludes Meta charges.

addOns.name: Advanced Analytics & Demand Insights
highlights: Inventory value, sell-through and stock cover
Demand trends, missed-sales reasons and size analysis
addOns.disclosure: Core sales dashboards remain included in every base plan.

featureGroups.subtitle: One catalogue for every type of item

featureCatalog.name: Email/password sign-in
featureCatalog.summary: Authenticates an active user and starts a JWT session.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Requires database availability.

featureCatalog.name: Google sign-in
featureCatalog.summary: Offers Google OAuth when client credentials are configured.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Hidden without Google environment variables; external OAuth not exercised.

featureCatalog.name: User registration
featureCatalog.summary: Creates an owner account and sends the user into verification/onboarding.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Mail delivery is environment-dependent.

featureCatalog.name: Email verification
featureCatalog.summary: Verifies signed tokens and supports resending a verification email.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Delivery requires configured email service.

featureCatalog.name: Forgot-password request
featureCatalog.summary: Accepts a recovery email request.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Endpoint intentionally returns success without generating/sending a reset link.

featureCatalog.name: Logout
featureCatalog.summary: Ends the authenticated session.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: None evident.

featureCatalog.name: Session refresh after onboarding
featureCatalog.summary: Refreshes JWT organization/store claims and guards dashboard entry.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: JWT-based; no server-side session revocation UI.

featureCatalog.name: Business onboarding
featureCatalog.summary: Creates an organization, initial store, and owner association.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: One initial store per onboarding submission.

featureCatalog.name: Team invitations
featureCatalog.summary: Owners/admins invite users with role and optional store scope.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Email delivery requires configuration.

featureCatalog.name: Invitation acceptance
featureCatalog.summary: Validates invite tokens and lets an invitee establish access.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Expired/revoked tokens are rejected.

featureCatalog.name: Role-based navigation
featureCatalog.summary: Limits menus for owner, admin, manager, staff, and routes super-admin separately.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Menu hiding is supplemented by API checks, but not every route has a dedicated role matrix test.

featureCatalog.name: Organization isolation
featureCatalog.summary: Scopes business records by organization and, where required, store.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Confidence is code/test based, not a formal security audit.

featureCatalog.name: Organization profile editing
featureCatalog.summary: Lets an owner change business name and view its immutable slug.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Editing is owner-only; slug cannot be changed.

featureCatalog.name: Two-factor authentication
featureCatalog.summary: Shows account 2FA state.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Explicitly displayed as inactive; no enrollment or verification flow.

featureCatalog.name: Store-scoped employee access
featureCatalog.summary: Assigns users to one store or all stores according to role.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Correct enforcement across every endpoint requires continuing review as routes are added.

featureCatalog.name: Product listing
featureCatalog.summary: Lists organization products with paging and stock-related details.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Mobile presentation is simpler than desktop.

featureCatalog.name: Product search
featureCatalog.summary: Searches by product name or SKU.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: No fuzzy-search engine.

featureCatalog.name: Product filters
featureCatalog.summary: Filters by category, brand, in-stock size, status and dynamic attributes.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Dynamic filters depend on category schema.

featureCatalog.name: Product creation wizard
featureCatalog.summary: Creates product basics, commercial data, image, attributes, variants and thresholds.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Requires at least one stocked size for active completion.

featureCatalog.name: Product editing
featureCatalog.summary: Updates existing product and its variants.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Historical sales retain snapshots rather than changing.

featureCatalog.name: Product detail
featureCatalog.summary: Shows product identity, pricing, variants and stock.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: None evident.

featureCatalog.name: Product deletion
featureCatalog.summary: Deletes a product through a confirmed action.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Database relationships may prevent deletion of referenced products.

featureCatalog.name: Draft/inactive products
featureCatalog.summary: Saves products inactive and later permits status changes.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: No separate draft revision history.

featureCatalog.name: SKU generation
featureCatalog.summary: Auto-generates/regenerates SKU from brand/category and supports variant SKU migration tools.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Uniqueness depends on API/database validation.

featureCatalog.name: External barcode capture
featureCatalog.summary: Stores EAN/UPC and supports camera entry.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Camera needs browser permission and HTTPS.

featureCatalog.name: Multi-price product data
featureCatalog.summary: Stores MRP, selling price and cost price for profitability and billing.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Currency is presented as INR in the UI.

featureCatalog.name: Product images
featureCatalog.summary: Uploads and displays a product image.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Needs valid blob credentials/network; no repository integration test.

featureCatalog.name: Product variants/sizes
featureCatalog.summary: Creates size/attribute combinations with quantity and low-stock level.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Variant model is named `Size` even when attributes are generic.

featureCatalog.name: Category management
featureCatalog.summary: Creates, edits, lists and deletes product categories.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Deletion can be constrained by referenced products.

featureCatalog.name: Category attribute schemas
featureCatalog.summary: Defines select, text, numeric and color-style attributes used by products.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Schema migrations for existing products are manual.

featureCatalog.name: Brand management
featureCatalog.summary: Creates, edits, lists and deletes brands.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Deletion can be constrained by products.

featureCatalog.name: Bulk category/brand/product import
featureCatalog.summary: Downloads templates, previews spreadsheet data, validates rows and submits bulk records.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Import is rejected while validation errors remain; large-file limits are not load-tested.

featureCatalog.name: Product duplication
featureCatalog.summary: Copies an existing product into a new editable product.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Requires the user to review/save; associated stock/history is intentionally not cloned.

featureCatalog.name: Store stock listing
featureCatalog.summary: Lists product variants, quantity and stock condition for the selected store.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Requires a selected/assigned store.

featureCatalog.name: Stock search and status filters
featureCatalog.summary: Searches by product/SKU/barcode and filters stock condition.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: No saved filters.

featureCatalog.name: Manual stock adjustment
featureCatalog.summary: Adds or removes stock with reason/reference and records a movement.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Not a formal two-party approval workflow.

featureCatalog.name: Stock movement history
featureCatalog.summary: Displays inbound, outbound, adjustment, sale and return history.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Retention/export settings are absent.

featureCatalog.name: Purchase receipt stock updates
featureCatalog.summary: Increases inventory when a purchase order is received.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: No partial receipt reversal UI.

featureCatalog.name: Sale/return inventory updates
featureCatalog.summary: Decrements sold stock and restores eligible returned units transactionally.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Exchange settlement complexity needs end-to-end verification.

featureCatalog.name: Barcode lookup
featureCatalog.summary: Resolves an internal SKU or external barcode to product/variant stock.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Store context is required for quantity.

featureCatalog.name: Camera barcode scanning
featureCatalog.summary: Reads barcodes using the device camera.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Hardware, permissions, HTTPS and device support require manual verification.

featureCatalog.name: Barcode label selection
featureCatalog.summary: Selects products/variants and quantities for label output.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Labels are product/variant based, not serial-number based.

featureCatalog.name: Barcode PDF/print output
featureCatalog.summary: Produces printable barcode sheets, previews them, or exports PDF.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Server PDF renderer/browser binaries must be deployable.

featureCatalog.name: Low-stock alert rules
featureCatalog.summary: Configures per-store/category/product thresholds, frequency and enablement.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Delivery channel behavior is not exposed in the form.

featureCatalog.name: Low-stock alert view
featureCatalog.summary: Shows currently low-stock items for configured rules.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Alerts are calculated on request.

featureCatalog.name: Scheduled reorder check
featureCatalog.summary: Protected cron endpoint evaluates low stock and sends communications.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Needs cron secret/scheduler; delivery provider behavior is limited.

featureCatalog.name: Stock report data
featureCatalog.summary: Returns filterable current-stock report rows.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: No file export button evident.

featureCatalog.name: Inventory transfer
featureCatalog.summary: Move stock directly between stores.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: No atomic source-to-destination transfer workflow.

featureCatalog.name: Historical stock reconstruction
featureCatalog.summary: Rebuilds prior on-hand quantities from movements for analytics.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Not available as a standalone ledger snapshot UI.

featureCatalog.name: Supplier directory
featureCatalog.summary: Lists and searches suppliers.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Desktop-oriented.

featureCatalog.name: Supplier creation/editing
featureCatalog.summary: Stores supplier company, contact, email, phone and address.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: No supplier portal.

featureCatalog.name: Supplier deletion
featureCatalog.summary: Removes a supplier when references permit it.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Referenced suppliers may be protected by DB relations.

featureCatalog.name: Supplier detail/history
featureCatalog.summary: Shows supplier information and associated purchasing history.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: No statement reconciliation.

featureCatalog.name: Purchase-order creation
featureCatalog.summary: Creates a supplier order with product, size, quantity, unit cost and notes.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Cannot create without catalog products.

featureCatalog.name: Purchase-order list/filter
featureCatalog.summary: Searches POs and filters by status and supplier.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: No export.

featureCatalog.name: PO detail and totals
featureCatalog.summary: Shows order identity, creator, supplier, line items, costs and status.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: None evident.

featureCatalog.name: PO submit/status workflow
featureCatalog.summary: Submits drafts and records order lifecycle state.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Approval hierarchy is absent.

featureCatalog.name: Receive purchase order
featureCatalog.summary: Records received quantities/cost and updates inventory.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: No vendor invoice attachment, landed-cost allocation, or receipt reversal UI.

featureCatalog.name: POS product search
featureCatalog.summary: Searches sellable stock by name or SKU with a 300 ms debounce and two-character minimum.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Search minimum does not apply to barcode lookup.

featureCatalog.name: POS barcode entry
featureCatalog.summary: Adds products by typed/scanned internal or external barcode.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Camera hardware is separately unverified.

featureCatalog.name: Cart management
featureCatalog.summary: Adds/removes variants and changes quantities with stock validation.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Cannot sell beyond available stock.

featureCatalog.name: Responsive cart drawer
featureCatalog.summary: Uses a compact drawer on narrow displays.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Manual viewport QA still recommended.

featureCatalog.name: Customer selection/quick creation
featureCatalog.summary: Searches, selects, or creates a customer during checkout.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Mobile number is the principal lookup key.

featureCatalog.name: Item price override
featureCatalog.summary: Applies per-line fixed/percentage negotiated pricing.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Authorization threshold for overrides is not evident.

featureCatalog.name: Sale-level discount
featureCatalog.summary: Applies a cart-level discount before payment.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Discount policy/approval controls are absent.

featureCatalog.name: Promo-code administration
featureCatalog.summary: Creates, edits, activates/deactivates and deletes promotions.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: No campaign scheduler UI.

featureCatalog.name: Promo-code validation/application
featureCatalog.summary: Applies code eligibility, value, limits and date rules at billing.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Some offer selection is store/date dependent.

featureCatalog.name: Tax calculation
featureCatalog.summary: Applies configured inclusive/exclusive tax and stores the result.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Primarily designed for GST-style percentage tax.

featureCatalog.name: Payment-method selection
featureCatalog.summary: Records cash, card, UPI and other schema-supported methods.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: No direct payment-gateway capture integration.

featureCatalog.name: Split payments
featureCatalog.summary: Allocates one checkout across multiple payment methods and validates the total.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Gateway settlement is outside the app.

featureCatalog.name: Partial/deferred payment
featureCatalog.summary: Creates balances and records later payments against a sale.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: No automated collections workflow.

featureCatalog.name: Backdated transaction date
featureCatalog.summary: Permits an authorized sale date different from creation time.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Authorization behavior needs business-policy review.

featureCatalog.name: Invoice numbering snapshot
featureCatalog.summary: Generates a store prefix/date/sequence number and snapshots invoice settings.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Concurrent sequence behavior needs production load verification.

featureCatalog.name: Invoice preview and print
featureCatalog.summary: Renders a printable invoice with business, customer, line, tax and payment details.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Browser print formatting should be manually checked.

featureCatalog.name: Invoice PDF generation
featureCatalog.summary: Generates downloadable invoice PDFs server-side.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Deployment browser/font/runtime must be validated.

featureCatalog.name: Sales history
featureCatalog.summary: Lists, filters and pages transactions, with cards/table and detail access.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: No general CSV export evident.

featureCatalog.name: Sales KPI widgets
featureCatalog.summary: Shows transaction count, revenue and operational billing KPIs.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: KPI correctness depends on legacy compatibility normalization.

featureCatalog.name: Keyboard/compact interaction aids
featureCatalog.summary: Supports scan-first input, quantity controls, tabbed/collapsible areas and responsive panels.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: No comprehensive keyboard-shortcut map or accessibility E2E suite.

featureCatalog.name: Original-sale lookup
featureCatalog.summary: Selects a completed sale and loads returnable quantities.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Limited to accessible organization/store sales.

featureCatalog.name: Full or partial return
featureCatalog.summary: Selects individual lines and quantities for return.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Cannot exceed unreturned quantity.

featureCatalog.name: Product exchange
featureCatalog.summary: Adds replacement products filtered by name/SKU/barcode/category/brand/size.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Exchange inventory must be available.

featureCatalog.name: Return reason/condition/notes
featureCatalog.summary: Captures operational context for returned goods.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Reason values are not a centrally administered catalog.

featureCatalog.name: Settlement calculation
featureCatalog.summary: Calculates refund due or additional amount for an exchange.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Complex legacy sale scenarios need manual sampling.

featureCatalog.name: Refund/supplement payment methods
featureCatalog.summary: Records cash/card/UPI/split settlement for return or exchange.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Does not reverse an external processor automatically.

featureCatalog.name: Returned/exchanged stock updates
featureCatalog.summary: Restocks returned items and decrements exchanged items atomically.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Damaged-item quarantine stock is not separately modeled.

featureCatalog.name: Return/exchange document history
featureCatalog.summary: Persists reference records linked to the original sale.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Dedicated return-document PDF/standalone returns register UI is not evident.

featureCatalog.name: Customer directory
featureCatalog.summary: Lists paged customers with stable URL state.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: None evident.

featureCatalog.name: Customer search
featureCatalog.summary: Searches by name/mobile and provides checkout lookup.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Phone normalization is India-oriented.

featureCatalog.name: Customer filters/sorting/paging
featureCatalog.summary: Filters purchase recency/KPI groups and sorts/paginates without stale query reuse.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Date presets use Asia/Kolkata business time.

featureCatalog.name: Customer registration
featureCatalog.summary: Creates customers directly or during billing/demand capture.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Duplicate policy centers on mobile.

featureCatalog.name: Customer profile editing
featureCatalog.summary: Updates customer identity/contact data.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: No customer self-service portal.

featureCatalog.name: Profile navigation context
featureCatalog.summary: Preserves filters and supports previous/next customer navigation across pages.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Navigation follows current filtered order only.

featureCatalog.name: Purchase history and spend summary
featureCatalog.summary: Shows invoices, last purchase, item summaries, spend and activity.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Legacy transaction normalization may affect older data.

featureCatalog.name: Customer invoice access
featureCatalog.summary: Previews/downloads only invoices belonging to the selected customer and store scope.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: PDF runtime separately unverified.

featureCatalog.name: Customer insights
featureCatalog.summary: Provides retention/value/recency-style directory insights.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Not a predictive ML model.

featureCatalog.name: Visit history
featureCatalog.summary: Records and lists visits associated with a customer.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Anonymous visits have no customer profile link.

featureCatalog.name: Follow-up creation/status
featureCatalog.summary: Creates scheduled customer follow-ups, links optional demand/restock context, and updates status.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: No calendar synchronization.

featureCatalog.name: Follow-up queue/notifications
featureCatalog.summary: Surface due follow-ups proactively to staff.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: No global due-today queue, push alert, email, or cron reminder was found.

featureCatalog.name: Loyalty program
featureCatalog.summary: Rewards points, tiers, redemption or wallet.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Spend analytics exists, but no loyalty program is implemented.

featureCatalog.name: Visit capture
featureCatalog.summary: Records dated store visits from walk-in, phone, WhatsApp or other sources.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Requires store selection.

featureCatalog.name: Anonymous/existing/new visitors
featureCatalog.summary: Supports anonymous visits, linking an existing customer, or registering one inline.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Anonymous visits cannot later be automatically merged.

featureCatalog.name: Visit outcomes
featureCatalog.summary: Records converted, partial, unconverted and browsing-style outcomes.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Outcome relies on employee entry.

featureCatalog.name: Unmet demand requests
featureCatalog.summary: Captures category, product, brand, reason, status, desired/fulfilled quantity and notes.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Manual capture quality affects analytics.

featureCatalog.name: Requested size/generic attributes
featureCatalog.summary: Captures size and category-defined requirements rather than assuming apparel fields.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Available fields depend on category schema.

featureCatalog.name: Visit update/detail
featureCatalog.summary: Reads and updates tenant/store-safe visit records.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: No bulk edit.

featureCatalog.name: Daily demand summary
featureCatalog.summary: Shows today’s visits, outcomes and missed requests.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Store-scoped.

featureCatalog.name: Lost-sale reason analysis
featureCatalog.summary: Aggregates why sales were lost.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Classification is rules-based.

featureCatalog.name: Demand vs availability/category analysis
featureCatalog.summary: Compares observed demand, fulfillment and availability by requested requirement/category.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Evidence level warns on small samples.

featureCatalog.name: Demand-to-procurement automation
featureCatalog.summary: Automatically creates replenishment/PO recommendations from unmet demand.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Managers must act on insights manually.

featureCatalog.name: Store dashboard KPIs
featureCatalog.summary: Shows sales, orders, inventory and business summary for store/date scope.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Values depend on selected store/date.

featureCatalog.name: Revenue trend
featureCatalog.summary: Charts revenue over time.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: No forecast.

featureCatalog.name: Stock by category
featureCatalog.summary: Visualizes inventory distribution across categories.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Current-state view.

featureCatalog.name: Top brands
featureCatalog.summary: Ranks brands from sales data.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Ranking basis follows selected period.

featureCatalog.name: Recent stock movements
featureCatalog.summary: Shows recent inventory changes.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Limited recent window.

featureCatalog.name: Sales/payment breakdown
featureCatalog.summary: Reports sales and payment-method distribution.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Mixed/partial payments depend on allocation records.

featureCatalog.name: Profit and margin analysis
featureCatalog.summary: Calculates revenue, COGS, gross profit and margin with returns/exchanges handled.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Accuracy depends on historical cost snapshots.

featureCatalog.name: Inventory intelligence periods
featureCatalog.summary: Supports week, month, quarter, half-year, year and custom comparisons.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Store required.

featureCatalog.name: Inventory value/sell-through/cover
featureCatalog.summary: Calculates stock value, units sold, fulfillment, sell-through and stock-cover metrics.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Stock cover can be semantically unavailable with zero velocity.

featureCatalog.name: Inventory diagnostics
featureCatalog.summary: Classifies healthy, overstock, demand weakness and replenishment/constraint risks with insights.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Diagnostic, not predictive.

featureCatalog.name: Category/product drill-down
featureCatalog.summary: Filters intelligence by category, brand and product and opens detail tables/charts.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Large-dataset performance not load-tested.

featureCatalog.name: Category-size heatmap
featureCatalog.summary: Visualizes category demand/stock behavior across sizes.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Relevant mainly where size-like variants exist.

featureCatalog.name: Raw movement report API
featureCatalog.summary: Supplies filterable stock-movement report data.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: No dedicated downloadable artifact.

featureCatalog.name: Integration overview
featureCatalog.summary: Shows connection state, assets, readiness, messaging activity and required actions.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Admin-only navigation.

featureCatalog.name: Meta embedded signup
featureCatalog.summary: Creates a secure signup session and exchanges completion data for tenant credentials/assets.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Live Meta authorization/credentials require external testing.

featureCatalog.name: Secure credential storage
featureCatalog.summary: Stores tenant access tokens by opaque reference and expiry.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Repository code cannot establish production secret-management policy.

featureCatalog.name: Business-account management
featureCatalog.summary: Lists, removes and synchronizes WhatsApp business accounts.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Live sync needs Meta.

featureCatalog.name: Phone-number management
featureCatalog.summary: Lists, removes and synchronizes phone numbers and statuses.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Live sync needs Meta.

featureCatalog.name: Store-to-sender mapping
featureCatalog.summary: Maps each store/purpose to a WhatsApp number.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Requires synced eligible number.

featureCatalog.name: Store WhatsApp profiles
featureCatalog.summary: Configures store messaging identity/settings.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Profile fields must align with Meta assets.

featureCatalog.name: Messaging readiness checks
featureCatalog.summary: Diagnoses credentials, sender mapping, templates and configuration before send.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Passing local readiness cannot guarantee Meta delivery.

featureCatalog.name: Integration health diagnostics
featureCatalog.summary: Reports connection/token/asset/template health and actionable errors.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: External provider outages remain outside control.

featureCatalog.name: Template synchronization
featureCatalog.summary: Imports/reconciles Meta templates and their statuses.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Live sync requires Meta.

featureCatalog.name: Merchant template creation
featureCatalog.summary: Creates merchant templates from validated options/blueprints.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Meta approval remains external.

featureCatalog.name: Invoice template variables
featureCatalog.summary: Resolves organization/store/customer/invoice variables for messages.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Template must contain compatible variables.

featureCatalog.name: Test messages
featureCatalog.summary: Sends a validated test message and presents errors.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Actual delivery needs valid Meta account/recipient.

featureCatalog.name: Invoice messaging
featureCatalog.summary: Queues/sends invoice templates with delivery feedback.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Live delivery and Meta template approval unverified.

featureCatalog.name: Immediate/cron invoice dispatch
featureCatalog.summary: Dispatches pending invoice jobs immediately or via protected worker endpoints.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Needs scheduler secret and deployment cron.

featureCatalog.name: Webhook ingestion/status updates
featureCatalog.summary: Verifies Meta webhooks, stores events, deduplicates, and updates message/conversation status.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Requires a public callback and Meta subscription.

featureCatalog.name: Message activity and detail
featureCatalog.summary: Lists outbound/inbound messages, statuses, errors and event detail.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Depends on webhook/dispatch data.

featureCatalog.name: Contacts and consent
featureCatalog.summary: Lists contacts and records purpose-specific opt-in/opt-out status.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Legal compliance still requires correct business processes.

featureCatalog.name: Conversation monitoring
featureCatalog.summary: Lists conversations and health/routing state with detail.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: No agent reply/composer or inbox assignment workflow found.

featureCatalog.name: Campaign management/execution
featureCatalog.summary: Creates, previews, schedules/executes campaigns, tracks recipients and metrics.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Live scale/delivery requires Meta and scheduler.

featureCatalog.name: Messaging automations
featureCatalog.summary: Configures trigger-based automated messages and records executions.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Only repository-defined triggers exist; end-to-end trigger coverage depends on callers.

featureCatalog.name: Campaign job queue
featureCatalog.summary: Claims due work, handles retries/recipient statuses and prevents unsafe cross-tenant execution.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: No general queue administration UI.

featureCatalog.name: Profile/access summary
featureCatalog.summary: Shows current name, email, role, organization and store access.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Self-edit is intentionally unavailable.

featureCatalog.name: User management
featureCatalog.summary: Creates/edits users, assigns roles/store, activates/deactivates and searches.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Owner/admin controls only.

featureCatalog.name: Administrator password reset
featureCatalog.summary: Lets an authorized administrator set a user’s new password.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Admin-set password, not emailed reset-token flow.

featureCatalog.name: Store management
featureCatalog.summary: Creates/edits/deactivates stores with code, address and phone.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Store code immutable after creation.

featureCatalog.name: Billing configuration
featureCatalog.summary: Configures invoice prefix and core billing settings.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: `settingsService.ts` contains an obsolete TODO comment, but the active API uses persisted organization settings.

featureCatalog.name: Invoice policy management
featureCatalog.summary: Configures seller identity, numbering/tax/payment/footer fields and versions policy.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Some changes affect only future invoice snapshots.

featureCatalog.name: Appearance/theme
featureCatalog.summary: Switches/persists application appearance.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: User-vs-organization persistence scope should be manually confirmed.

featureCatalog.name: Self-service profile/security editing
featureCatalog.summary: Lets a user change their own name, email and password.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: No self-service editor.

featureCatalog.name: App settings persistence service
featureCatalog.summary: Generic settings hook/service intended to back configuration.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Service explicitly says to replace with Prisma; persistence can be lost or diverge from API-backed settings.

featureCatalog.name: Color palette/naming system
featureCatalog.summary: Supplies named colors, shades and reusable color UI utilities.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Image color extraction returns an empty placeholder result.

featureCatalog.name: Expense transactions
featureCatalog.summary: Creates, edits, lists and deletes store expenses.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Manager/admin access.

featureCatalog.name: Expense categories
featureCatalog.summary: Creates and manages categorized expense options.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: No category hierarchy.

featureCatalog.name: Expense filters
featureCatalog.summary: Filters transactions by store, dates, category and status.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: No saved views.

featureCatalog.name: Recurring expense templates
featureCatalog.summary: Marks expenses recurring, lists templates and stops recurrence.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: No scheduler that automatically posts each recurrence was found.

featureCatalog.name: Monthly category budgets
featureCatalog.summary: Sets category budgets by store/month/year.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Alerts are visual; no push/email job found.

featureCatalog.name: Budget-vs-actual warnings
featureCatalog.summary: Shows utilization and 90%/100% warning states.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Does not prevent overspend.

featureCatalog.name: Expense analytics
featureCatalog.summary: Shows month/year totals, top category, category pie and monthly trend.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Descriptive analytics only.

featureCatalog.name: GST/ITC register
featureCatalog.summary: Summarizes GST paid, claimable ITC, registered vendors and line detail.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: No tax filing/export integration.

featureCatalog.name: Advanced expense workspace
featureCatalog.summary: Provides advanced expense tabs/settings.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Some advanced concepts are presentation over existing data, not separate workflows.

featureCatalog.name: Accounting ledger/reconciliation
featureCatalog.summary: General ledger, chart of accounts, bank reconciliation and journal entries.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Expense/GST reporting is not full accounting.

featureCatalog.name: Payroll/salary processing
featureCatalog.summary: Computes salary, deductions, payslips and payroll disbursement.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Attendance exists, but payroll does not.

featureCatalog.name: Expense summary API
featureCatalog.summary: Supplies aggregated expense totals for other screens.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Not independently user-facing.

featureCatalog.name: Staff check-in
featureCatalog.summary: Records an employee’s store attendance start.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: No biometric/geofence validation.

featureCatalog.name: Staff check-out
featureCatalog.summary: Records end time and calculated duration.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: No break tracking.

featureCatalog.name: Attendance history/summary
featureCatalog.summary: Lists date-range history and counts present/leave/weekly-off states.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Timezone behavior should be manually verified around midnight.

featureCatalog.name: Attendance override
featureCatalog.summary: Allows workforce managers to correct attendance.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: No dedicated immutable correction audit view.

featureCatalog.name: Leave application
featureCatalog.summary: Employees request dated leave by type/reason.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: No attachment support.

featureCatalog.name: Leave approval/rejection/cancel
featureCatalog.summary: Managers decide requests and employees can cancel eligible requests.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: No multi-level approval.

featureCatalog.name: Store leave policies/balances
featureCatalog.summary: Sets allowed leave by type and maintains balances.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Accrual rules are simple annual limits.

featureCatalog.name: Weekly-off configuration
featureCatalog.summary: Configures recurring weekly days off by user/store.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: No rich shift/roster planner.

featureCatalog.name: Super-admin bootstrap/login
featureCatalog.summary: Bootstraps and authenticates a platform super-admin.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Bootstrap must be secured operationally.

featureCatalog.name: Platform dashboard
featureCatalog.summary: Shows platform-wide organization/user/store/product/revenue-style stats.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Metric definitions should be validated with production data.

featureCatalog.name: Organization directory/detail
featureCatalog.summary: Searches, filters and inspects tenant organizations.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Sensitive platform access is super-admin only.

featureCatalog.name: Organization suspension action
featureCatalog.summary: Suspends/unsuspends a tenant from its detail panel.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Handler is an explicit TODO.

featureCatalog.name: Platform user directory
featureCatalog.summary: Searches, pages and manages platform-wide users.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Destructive/account actions require manual verification.

featureCatalog.name: Pricing plan catalog
featureCatalog.summary: Displays Free/Pro/Enterprise plans, limits and feature matrix.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Comment explicitly says backend will own plans later; edits are not persisted.

featureCatalog.name: Feature flags
featureCatalog.summary: Creates/updates/deletes platform flags with targeting/value state.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Runtime consumption by product modules is limited/not centrally evident.

featureCatalog.name: Announcements
featureCatalog.summary: Creates, edits, deletes and schedules platform announcements.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Tenant-facing rendering is not clearly exposed.

featureCatalog.name: Platform analytics
featureCatalog.summary: Shows organization/user/product/store growth and plan distribution.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: No export/warehouse integration.

featureCatalog.name: Admin audit log
featureCatalog.summary: Stores and searches privileged actions by actor/action/target.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Not every non-admin tenant action is audited.

featureCatalog.name: Mobile viewport workspace
featureCatalog.summary: Switches to touch-oriented dashboard components on small screens.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Device-matrix QA is not automated.

featureCatalog.name: Mobile dashboard/navigation
featureCatalog.summary: Provides bottom navigation, cards, list items and floating actions.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Not every desktop module has a dedicated mobile page.

featureCatalog.name: Mobile catalog/stock
featureCatalog.summary: Provides mobile products, categories, brands and stock pages with compact search/filter patterns.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Advanced product filters are primarily desktop.

featureCatalog.name: Mobile POS and split payment
featureCatalog.summary: Provides touch cart, filters and split payment controls.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Hardware/payment delivery still external.

featureCatalog.name: Responsive coverage beyond core modules
featureCatalog.summary: Makes administration, reports, expenses, purchasing and WhatsApp fully feature-equivalent on mobile.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Dedicated mobile implementations exist only for core dashboard/catalog/stock/billing; some dense tables remain desktop-oriented.

featureCatalog.name: Public marketing landing page
featureCatalog.summary: Presents product value, industries, calls to action and demo-request form.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Lead routing/notification destination requires environment review.

featureCatalog.name: Interactive product demo
featureCatalog.summary: Provides a self-contained guided UI demonstration.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: Demo actions are illustrative and do not persist real business data.

featureCatalog.name: Email/communication delivery
featureCatalog.summary: Sends verification, invitation, alert or other communications through configured providers.
featureCatalog.auditLimitations: External provider configuration and delivery were not exercised.
